reason: My booking system already has an online booking button, and my front desk takes the calls anyway. I'd have to change how my staff and customers work for a chat box I'd only glance at, and I don't see the website as where my jobs come from.
objection: It sounds like a second booking tool on top of the one I already pay for, and I don't know what the AI will say to a customer when it's unsure.
would_change_my_mind: If it showed me, with real chats, that it books jobs my phone and existing booking button miss, and it plugged into my current booking system instead of running alongside it.
